messages.subject: Re: Simple output for A, Ho, He, and ne
messages.subject_clean: Simple output for A, Ho, He, and ne
messages.body_plain:
Hi Arthur,

Thanks for posting that updated function.
When I tried to run it, I got the following error: "Starting gl.report.heterozygosity
Error in gl.filter.monomorphs(x, verbose = 0) :
  unused argument (verbose = 0) "

So I changed it to the following (replacing the first "verbose" with "v") and it worked:
 # Check for monomorphic loci
    tmp <- gl.filter.monomorphs(x, v=0)
    if ((nLoc(tmp) < nLoc(x)) & verbose >= 2) {
      cat("  Warning: genlight object contains monomorphic loci\n")
    }

(seems to have been the same problem in my question about the gl2svdquartets function).

Just following up on Chad's question, is there a way to get FIS per population somehow?

Cheers,

On Monday, June 24, 2019 at 7:18:31 PM UTC+10, Chad Beranek wrote:

> Hey guys,
>
> I was also wondering if there is any function to give a report of the allelic diversity (A), observed heterozyosity (Ho), expected heterozygosity (He), and allelic diversity (ne), per population?
>
> I have tried the functions gl.Ho and gl.Hs, but these seem to only calculate parameters per loci. I can't seem to find a function to isolate an entire population to calculate these parameters.
>
> I have also tried the gl.report.heterozygosity function, but this has not worked for me yet. I have left the computer running for 24 hours + with no results. This includes after rigorous filtering (100% RepAvg and 98% call rate), getting the data down to 6724 SNPs
>
> Any help of the easiest approach to obtain these parameters for each population would be hugely appreciated.
>
> Kind regards,
> Chad
>

messages.subject: Re: Filtering missing data "-"
messages.body_plain:
Hi Peco,

Package dartR is designed to pick up from the 2Row, 1Row and SilicoDArT files generated by Diversity Arrays Technology. We do not delve back past that boundary, and so do not have the information required to include threshold options. You could request Diversity Arrays Technology to adjust the threshold for calling a tag presence or absence.

As for filtering the SilicoDArT for missing values, we have not completed addition of scripts to handle tag presence/absence data. I have attached two scripts that will be in the rebuild after next.

Sorry I could not be of more help.

A

messages.subject_clean: behaviour of population ordering for genlight and gl.pcoa/glpca
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I'm curious about how to control the ordering of the populations in a genlight file and specifically WRT running gl.pcoa or glpca analysis. If I look at pops in my genlight file via e.g. my.gl <http://my.gl>$pops I have a particular order - I presume it was the input order of my data originally.  However, when I run gl.pca the order of my pops is alphabetical (as seen in the assignment of colours and in the legend. I would like to be able to control population order in both my genlight and any outputs from gl.pcoa (or glpca). Any advice? I'm sure its straightforward.
Cheers,
Olly
